facebook.caption:
POV: you skipped the resort beach crowd and found Bãi Trường wide open.

Sonasea Public Beach sits right on one of Phu Quoc's longest stretches of coastline. No wristband. No resort fee. Just sand, water, and space to breathe.

4.4 stars from 120 reviews. Solid for a free public beach on a busy strip.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
